link.note: Tree shows him as William Wells of Southold's father. Hayes (1878) identified the Southold man with his son only 'according to family tradition'; Round 3 disproved it: the prebendary's son William (bapt. St Peter Mancroft, Norwich, 10 Feb 1604/5) became Rev. William Wells, vicar of North Elmham, Norfolk, and died in England in 1680 (CCEd person 12847; WikiTree Wells-639). Not an ancestor.

aka: Rev. William Wells to the Queen of Denmark (tree)
summary: Disproven father of William Wells; a Norwich prebendary and chaplain to Queen Anne of Denmark.
bio: Norwich prebendary and 'Chaplain to the Queen (Anne of Denmark)', wife of James I; died 26 May 1620. His will names wife Elizabeth and sons John and William. The tree's title 'to the Queen of Denmark' garbles this. The baptism also conflicted with the tree's 1608 birth for William Wells.
